events.name: Decaying Shrapnel Scatter
events.description: A fragmented solar array bracket de-orbits over District 8, shedding small hypervelocity titanium slivers across the upper sector.

events.name: Tungsten Penetrator Plunge
events.description: An intact 50-kilogram military defense ballast rod plunges into the permafrost, punching deep into overhead bedrock.

events.name: Telemetry Station Cluster Strike
events.description: A bus of decayed communications satellites breaks into four burning masses, raking across contiguous shelter roof quadrants.

events.name: Sub-Orbital Airburst Shockwave
events.description: A hydrazine fuel tank detonates at 15 kilometres altitude. Atmospheric overpressure shakes the bunker foundation and rattles electrical busbars.

events.name: Rapid-Decay High-Density Core
events.description: A dense orbital turbine hub on an unpredictable decaying orbit enters the atmosphere with less than 24 hours of radar warning.
